certificates.description: Signing certificate fingerprint shared by the primary and embedded APK artifacts.

notes: APK SHA-256 values identify complete APK artifacts.
Certificate SHA-256 identifies the signing certificate and is not an APK file hash.
The shared signing certificate does not establish common source code, publisher identity, or execution linkage.
All values should be independently verified against preserved original artifacts before operational use.
